name: @yakult-green-tea/qq-music-api
description: 非官方的 QQ 音乐 API，支持扫码登录、个人音乐库和播放链接，可以独立部署，也可以嵌入 Node.js、Electron 或 Serverless。

scripts.clean:dist: node -e "for (const d of ['dist','dist-esm']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build:js: npm run clean:dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --outDir dist && npm run build:types && npm run build:esm && node scripts/prepare-runtime-assets.js
scripts.test:contracts: jest --runInBand --coverage=false --setupFilesAfterEnv ./tests/helpers/offlineNetwork.cjs --runTestsByPath tests/folia.http-contracts.test.ts tests/folia.persistence-contracts.test.ts tests/serverless.closure-contracts.test.ts tests/package.artifact.test.ts tests/capabilities.routes.test.ts tests/recommendation.capabilities.test.ts tests/protocol.errors.test.ts tests/transport.musicu.test.ts tests/transport.hosts.test.ts tests/negative.http-contracts.test.ts tests/playlist.track-writes.routes.test.ts tests/subscriptions.routes.test.ts tests/recommend.routes.test.ts tests/daily-songs.routes.test.ts tests/daily-history.routes.test.ts tests/blacklist.read.routes.test.ts tests/blacklist.write.routes.test.ts tests/radio.recommendation.routes.test.ts tests/guess-you-like.modes.routes.test.ts tests/operations.music-play-controlled-hints.test.ts tests/services.qr-login.test.ts tests/operations.qr-check.test.ts tests/errors.runtime-baseline.test.ts tests/song.like.routes.test.ts tests/album.subscribe.routes.test.ts tests/search.routes.test.ts tests/folia.login-contracts.test.ts tests/folia.wiring-contracts.test.ts tests/operations.music-play-preview.test.ts tests/operations.login-channels.test.ts tests/login.refresh.routes.test.ts tests/user.vip.routes.test.ts tests/recommend-new-albums.routes.test.ts tests/recommend-toplists.routes.test.ts tests/recommend-radar.routes.test.ts tests/user-cloud.routes.test.ts tests/playlist.management.routes.test.ts tests/operations.user-playlist-detail.test.ts tests/radio.routes.test.ts tests/recommend-catalog.routes.test.ts tests/song-relations.routes.test.ts tests/operations.music-play-retry.test.ts tests/operations.music-play-quality.test.ts tests/getSingerAlbum.test.ts tests/getSingerHotsong.test.ts
